steps: Open Settings in the real native panel as an isolated guest.
Choose Dark and set a disposable local engine port through trusted native-panel input; verify two independent local keys.
Seed one harmless guest session value in the isolated extension profile, and verify it exists.
Open Clear local data, Cancel; verify theme, port, and exact harmless session value remain.
Reopen and Confirm; wait for both local and session clear, then verify every pre-confirm key was removed.
Reload the panel; verify guest UI, System default, and no persisted theme, port, or session fixture.
